trigger_condition: The sole conflicted note is reopened from Studies while its current association remains selected.
potential_consequence: Reopening never offers conflict departure or reloads the latest saved note.

trigger_condition: Browser Back activates a live tab containing an unchanged selected-word pane.
guard_snippet: Preserve live pane generations when pane identity and reference match the incoming snapshot.
potential_consequence: Fresh generations invalidate retained selections, clearing word analysis and its saved filters.

trigger_condition: Two tabs display different long notes and users switch after scrolling each.
guard_snippet: Capture and restore the inspector scroll position by tab and note identity.
potential_consequence: Retained note hosts reuse the other tab's inspector position, losing the original reading position.
